Tips: Collect enough stars in one Season, to move on to the next!
Your Team always plays from the Left side of the screen!
The front of a player's card displays all the numbers that the player can roll!
Midfielders can be used as either Forwards or Defenders!
The Central Forward will always be the one to attempt a Goal. Choose well!
Add players to your Bench! Substitute them later on once your game begins.
Upgrade your players periodically by hiring those with better numbers!
Pay attention to the requirements for your players' abilities and develop stunning combos!
New players often bring new abilities or easier conditions to trigger them!
Remember to fill up your Bench when you can! This will allow you to adapt to new threats!
You can tap on Locked players too to read their cards!
You can use in-app purchases to unlock any player, any time!
It's ok to lose a match! You'll still unlock the next league game and can come back later!
You will still have to pay the hiring fee after unlocking a player via in-app.
The hiring fee for locked players can be seen by tapping the Unlock button.
Midfielders are very useful and can be accessed from any slot except for Goalie!
Use the Play On button to interrupt a long play, if you've already won that turn!
Constantly upgrading your players is key to scoring well!
Find players whose abilities complement each other. Read the back of their cards!
The numbers available for each player to roll are displayed on the front of the card.
You can replay any match any time to improve your score or earn more cash!
League matches just need to be completed in order to unlock the next!
Tournament matches must be Won in order to unlock the next!
Tournament matches offer no cash, but a BIG prize in the finals.
Tap Unlock on Locked players to find out how to Unlock them.
Completing achievements always unlocks more players or kits!
Re-rolls are vital in building great combo chains!
Always be on the look out for new players that have better numbers than yours!
Explore the criteria required for unlocking new players by tapping the Unlock button.
You can get more coins and kits by visiting the shop!
Running low on credits? Go to the shop to stock up on more!
Change into your new uniforms by visiting the locker room from the Manage screen.
It's always a good idea to preview the enemy team before going in to Play.
Click the refresh button in the Trophy Room to check for missed achievements.
Through Pass can be a great way to plough through a tough defense!
You can Tap the sides of the screen instead of shaking the device!
Always play Feint on your own dice!
